content.title: Why Dada Nexus Stock Popped Today
content.summary: Shares of Dada Nexus (NASDAQ: DADA) were soaring today on news that JD.com (NASDAQ: JD) had proposed acquiring all of its outstanding shares for $2 per American Depositary Share.  JD.com, the Chinese e-commerce giant and China's largest direct online seller, offered to buy out its on-demand delivery partner at a 42% premium today.  JD.com has not released a statement on the offer yet, but presumably, the company is proposing an acquisition because it thinks Dada Nexus is a good value at the price.
